pages.text:
Renewable coal. The Hydrothermal Carbonizer cooks biomass in hot water into Bio-Coal, with heat (HU, no FE), and only at 200°C or hotter.
- 8 biomass + 500 mB Water make 1 Bio-Coal in 10 seconds, using 6,000 HU. 300 mB of the water comes back out into its second tank.
- Biomass (#arcforge:biomass): crops, seeds, leaves, saplings, sticks, vines, kelp, Press Cake and Compost. A Tree Cutter's leaves and sticks are a steady supply.
- Sides: input on top (items and Water), output underneath (Bio-Coal and returned water), heat at the back.
- Speed and Heat upgrades.

Bio-Coal works as coal everywhere:
- It burns as long as coal in furnaces and every Arcforge burner; a Block of Bio-Coal as long as a block of coal.
- The Carbonizer bakes it into Coal Coke and Creosote, like coal.
- The Arc Crusher grinds it into Carbon Dust.
Nine make a Block of Bio-Coal.
